name: nikui-app
description: The NikUI phone app: a native shell around the same client the editor runs.

scripts.sync: node tools/version.js && node tools/build.js && npx cap sync && node tools/xcode.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.release:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
